prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop web decision comp, first viewport
Primary request: Create one finished Institutional Risk Dashboard for Market Mate, a display-only, read-only supervisory interface for one Principal overseeing an autonomous trading system. This is category-standard mature financial and observability software, played straight at exceptional craft. No novelty motif, no marketing, no moodboard, no wireframe.
Canvas: exact landscape 16:10 composition for 1440x900.
Structure, in order and with clear scale relationships:
1. Persistent left sidebar, 224 px wide, light neutral surface. Compact Market Mate wordmark at top. Navigation labels: Overview, Attention, Performance, Capital, Costs, Evidence, Decision Records. Overview selected. Bottom utility labels: System Map, Audit Export, Settings.
2. Main workspace. Top status strip spanning the content width with exact labels: "LOCAL RESEARCH", "Display only", "Read-only", "Zero order authority", "Last verified 3 min ago". Visually explicit stage and authority boundaries.
3. Page header: "Supervisory Overview" with subtitle "Evidence, capital, cost, and safety posture". Right side neutral controls: "Environment: Local Research", "Evidence window: 2 cycles", "Export".
4. First row: a wide Attention Queue card occupying about 60% and a narrower System Posture card about 40%. Attention Queue title with amber count 3. Three dense rows: "Operating cost cap exceeded" with severity High and status Needs review; "Evidence cycle 02 freshness warning" with status Due in 4h; "Checkpoint package ready" with status Verified. Each has a right-chevron drill-down affordance. System Posture shows stacked exact facts: "Qualification Passed", "Checkpoints Verified", "Evidence cycles 2 / 2", "Order authority None", with restrained green/blue/neutral indicators, not celebration.
5. Second row: dominant "After-cost performance" chart taking about two-thirds width and "Cash position" card one-third. Performance chart is a precise time-series plot with two thin lines labeled "Gross research return" and "After-cost research return", light grid, shaded cost drag between lines, date ticks Cycle 01 and Cycle 02, and a conspicuous note "Research evidence — not executable performance". Show internally labeled values only: Gross +2.4%, After cost +0.7%, Cost drag -1.7%. Cash position shows a restrained donut or segmented bar and exact labels: "Available cash $82,400", "Research allocation $12,600", "Reserved $5,000", "Total capital $100,000". Clearly local research, not brokerage execution.
6. Third row: "Operating costs" card and "Evidence freshness" card at equal width. Operating costs shows Current cycle "$1,940", Cap "$1,500", "129% of cap", amber-to-red horizontal threshold bar, and compact cost breakdown: Data $780, Compute $640, Storage $120, Other $400. Evidence freshness shows two evidence-cycle rows with exact labels: "Cycle 01 · Verified · 12h ago", "Cycle 02 · Warning · 20h ago", source lineage mini-bars, and a "View lineage" drill-down link.
7. Compact footer status line inside the viewport: "Audit chain intact" and "Last preserved evidence 3 min ago".
Style/medium: highly polished enterprise SaaS UI screenshot, crisp typography, realistic information density, precise charts, neutral controls, clean grid, quiet cards, subtle 1px borders, restrained shadows only where needed.
Color palette: background #F7F8FA, primary text #111827, blue #3157C8, amber #D97706, red #B42318; use muted grays and restrained success green only for verified state.
Typography: modern neutral grotesk/sans, compact numeric typography with tabular figures, strong hierarchy, all labels legible and spelled exactly.
Composition/framing: straight-on desktop screenshot, no device frame, no browser chrome, no perspective, no rounded outer canvas.
Constraints: owner-only context; display-only; read-only; Stage 1 local_research; zero order authority; checkpoints verified; qualification passed; operating costs over caps; exactly two evidence cycles. Simultaneously communicate trust and safety, attention, after-cost performance, cash and capital, costs, evidence freshness, and drill-down affordances. Do not imply trading control. Do not show buy, sell, approve, execute, pause, or emergency action buttons.
Avoid: marketing language, testimonials, third-party claims, invented benchmarks, invented dates, fabricated customers, promotional claims, sci-fi styling, glassmorphism, neon, decorative gradients, novelty motifs, oversized cards, excessive whitespace, stock photos, illustrations, device mockups, browser chrome, mobile layout, dark mode, illegible microtext, generic lorem ipsum, order-entry widgets, candlestick charts, brokerage trade controls, live-market implications, mixed Paper and Live records.
